property_summary: For every caller address that is a contract (i.e., msg.sender is a contract), calling setOwner through that contract must fail to change C.owner unless the contract itself is the current owner (reference enforces msg.sender==owner); the mutant (which compares msg.sender==tx.origin) can be tricked by a proxy contract so a call from a non-owner contract succeeds when tx.origin is the owner, causing owner() to differ.
change_summary: Replaced require check to compare msg.sender to tx.origin, which can change who is authorized and thus whether setOwner succeeds, affecting owner after the call.
